# `mise select`

- **Usage:** `mise select [--alias] [--run] [PRESETS]…`
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/select.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/select.rs)

Pick several tasks to run from a menu

Opens a menu of tasks grouped by folder, the part of a task's name before its last `:`. Press space to check a task, `a` to check or uncheck all, and `/` to filter; checking a folder's line runs every task in it. Enter runs the checked tasks as if they were named with `:::`, and Esc cancels.

`--run` runs the presets without opening the menu.

The same as `mise run --select`, which also takes `mise run` flags. Global flags go before `select`, such as `mise -j 1 select` to run the tasks one at a time.

## Arguments
- **`[PRESETS]…`** — Task names, aliases, or folders to check when the menu opens

## Flags
- **`--alias`** — Show task aliases in the menu
- **`--run`** — Run the presets without opening the menu
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Pick tasks to run

```
mise select
```

Pick tasks, with "lint" and every task in the "test" folder checked

```
mise select lint test
```

Run every task in the "build" folder, without the menu

```
mise select --run build
```

Pick tasks and run them one at a time

```
mise -j 1 select
```
